seed_everything: seed random number generators for reproducibility across numpy, torch, and cuda with a given seed value
freeze_module: freeze all parameters of a PyTorch nn.Module by setting requires_grad to False for fine-tuning
Timer: time a code block using the Timer context manager to measure elapsed time with start and end logging
PILtoTorch: convert a PIL Image or numpy array to a normalized PyTorch tensor with channel-first shape
get_expon_lr_func: build an exponential learning rate scheduler function that decays from lr_init to lr_final over max_steps
